name: The Saltreach
description: A pale desert of salt and sand, crossed by a single beaten road.

dune_road.name: Dune Road
dune_road.description: The road runs between low dunes, its ruts filled with wind-blown sand. The heat comes up off the ground in waves.

dry_wash.name: Dry Wash
dry_wash.description: A broad gully where a river used to run, its bed cracked like old pottery. The road dips into it and out again on the far side.

village_approach.name: Approach to Dunhallow
village_approach.description: Flat roofs and a green smear of date palms rise out of the heat haze ahead. The road widens here and runs up to a low mud-brick gate.
